run_a.engineering_meaning: Every valve requires pneumatic proof testing at or above 1.5 times MEOP.
normalized_constraints: For every valve: pneumatic_proof_pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP.

run_b.engineering_meaning: Every valve requires a pneumatic proof-pressure test at not less than 1.5 times MEOP.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: all valves.
Test type: pneumatic proof-pressure test.
Proof pressure >= 1.5 × MEOP.

run_a.engineering_meaning: The proof-pressure capability must be demonstrated for every unit during assembly, pressurizing each line individually and the housing separately through the actuation ram chamber while lines are vented.
normalized_constraints: For every unit during assembly: apply pressure individually to each line.
For every unit during assembly: apply pressure separately to the valve housing through the actuation ram chamber while the lines are vented.

run_b.engineering_meaning: The applicable proof-pressure capability must be demonstrated on every unit during assembly, using separate pressure applications to each line and to the housing through the actuation ram chamber while lines are vented.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: every unit.
Timing: during assembly.
Apply pressure individually to each line.
Apply pressure separately to valve housing through actuation ram chamber.
Vent lines during housing pressure application.

run_a.engineering_meaning: The applicable proof/leak test must cover every parent-metal shear-section and every valve part exposed to pressure after actuation.
normalized_constraints: Test all parent-metal shear-sections.
Test all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.

run_b.engineering_meaning: The test applies to every parent-metal shear-section and every valve part that will be pressure-exposed after actuation.
normalized_constraints: Test coverage includes all parent-metal shear-sections.
Test coverage includes all valve parts exposed to pressure after valve actuation.

run_a.engineering_meaning: Each weld must undergo leak testing, performed during assembly or during acceptance testing.
normalized_constraints: For all welds: leak_test performed during assembly OR acceptance testing.

run_b.engineering_meaning: Every weld must receive leak testing, performed at either the assembly stage or acceptance-testing stage.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: all welds.
Required action: leak test.
Permitted timing: during assembly OR during acceptance testing.

run_a.engineering_meaning: Defect risk must be addressed through either non-destructive acceptance testing or process control.
normalized_constraints: Perform non-destructive acceptance testing OR mitigate defect risk through process control.

run_b.engineering_meaning: Defect risk must be addressed by one of two alternatives: conduct non-destructive acceptance testing or mitigate defect risk through process control.
normalized_constraints: Required alternative: non-destructive acceptance testing OR defect-risk mitigation through process control.

run_a.engineering_meaning: Where process control is selected, NASA Fracture Control Board approval is required for spacecraft whose programmatic requirements require it.
normalized_constraints: IF process_control is used AND programmatic requirements require it for the spacecraft, THEN obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval.

run_b.engineering_meaning: When process control is used, obtain NASA Fracture Control Board approval for spacecraft whose programmatic requirements require that approval.
normalized_constraints: IF process control is used AND programmatic requirements require NASA Fracture Control Board approval for the spacecraft, THEN obtain that approval.

run_a.engineering_meaning: If fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used for NASA-STD-5019 compliance, the fracture-control authority must receive a demonstration that growth of the maximum credible crack is non-credible, using knowledge of applicable quality-control and manufacturing techniques.
normalized_constraints: IF fracture mechanics and crack-growth analysis are used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate to the fracture control authority that maximum credible crack growth is non-credible.
Base the demonstration on knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used for the valve.

run_b.engineering_meaning: If fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used for NASA-STD-5019 compliance verification, demonstrate to the fracture-control authority that growth of the maximum credible crack is non-credible, based on manufacturing and quality-control knowledge.
normalized_constraints: IF fracture-mechanics and crack-growth analysis is used to verify NASA-STD-5019 compliance, THEN demonstrate maximum credible crack growth is non-credible to the fracture control authority.
Basis includes knowledge of quality-control and manufacturing techniques used for the valve.

run_a.engineering_meaning: The valve must be capable of survival for four times its design operational life, regardless of the technical method used to establish the capability.
normalized_constraints: Valve survival capability >= 4 × design operational life.

run_b.engineering_meaning: Regardless of how the capability is technically established, the valve must survive at least four times its design operational life.
normalized_constraints: Valve survivability >= 4 × design operational life.

run_a.engineering_meaning: A valve intended to provide two separate, independent pre-actuation parent-metal barriers must demonstrate that capability by specified independent and external proof-test applications, without permanent deformation or leakage during LAT.
normalized_constraints: IF the valve design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN proof test each parent-metal shear-section independently at 1.5 × MEOP.
Then apply the proof test externally to the shear-section when welded in the housing.
During LAT, permanent deformation = none AND leakage = none.

run_b.engineering_meaning: A design intended to provide two separate independent parent-metal flow barriers before actuation must be verified by 1.5×MEOP proof testing of each shear-section independently and then externally after housing welding, without permanent deformation or leakage during LAT.
normalized_constraints: IF design provides two separate and independent parent-metal barriers before actuation, THEN proof-test at 1.5 × MEOP.
Apply proof pressure independently to each parent-metal shear-section.
Then apply proof pressure externally to the shear-section after it is welded in the housing.
Acceptance criterion during LAT: no evidence of permanent deformation AND no leakage.

run_a.engineering_meaning: Each burst-pressure test must maintain its test condition for at least five minutes.
normalized_constraints: For each burst-pressure test: hold_time >= 5 min.

run_b.engineering_meaning: Every burst-pressure test must maintain its test condition for at least five minutes.
normalized_constraints: Applies to: each burst-pressure test.
Burst-test hold time >= 5 min.

run_a.engineering_meaning: The minimum design burst-pressure multiplier depends on line diameter: 2.5 times MEOP for lines at least 3.8 cm (1.5 in) in diameter, and 4.0 times MEOP for smaller lines.
normalized_constraints: IF line_diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum_design_burst_pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line_diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum_design_burst_pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.

run_b.engineering_meaning: The minimum design burst-pressure multiplier depends on line diameter: 2.5×MEOP for lines at least 3.8 cm (1.5 in) in diameter, and 4.0×MEOP for smaller lines.
normalized_constraints: IF line diameter >= 3.8 cm (>= 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 2.5 × MEOP.
IF line diameter < 3.8 cm (< 1.5 in), THEN minimum design burst pressure >= 4.0 × MEOP.

run_a.engineering_meaning: The applicable design burst-pressure capability must be demonstrated using at least one NC parent-metal valve from every manufacturing lot.
normalized_constraints: For each valve lot: number_of_NC_parent_metal_valves_demonstrating_burst_pressure_capability >= 1.

run_b.engineering_meaning: The applicable burst-pressure capability must be demonstrated using no fewer than one NC parent-metal valve from every manufacturing lot.
normalized_constraints: Sampling basis: each lot.
Minimum test sample: >= 1 NC parent-metal valve per lot.
Demonstrate the applicable NCPR 28 burst-pressure capability.
